frame_test.definition: level-4 masked CT; mask eroded 5 vox (0.69 mm); 3-D structure tensor sd 1.0 / si 2.0 vox sampled every 4 vox (552.96 um); planar coherence (w2-w1)/w2 >= 0.4; axis = eigenvector of the smallest eigenvalue of mean(n n^T); ratio = l0/l1; tilt = angle to the nearest volume axis

phantom.bars: roll phantom: recovered axis within 1 deg of truth and l0/l1 <= 0.1; flat-stack phantom: stack direction within 1 deg and l0/l1 >= 0.5 (no axis). Evidence about the code path only.

reading: Only PHerc1451 shows a roll frame in the layering normals (l0/l1 0.36 against 0.82-0.94 for the other three volumes, PHerc0268 included); its axis is the volume z axis within 2.7 deg and is stable along the scroll outside the top end.
